sourceRefs.locator: Section 1, chronology table for Bun’ei 11. Departure from Happo in the tenth lunar month and arrival in northern Kyushu later that month.
정의 and 내용. The historic Happo district around modern Masan in Changwon; its role in the expeditions of the late Goryeo period.
Summary and 내용 on Happo’s Goryeo-era tax warehouse and the earlier Na-po port in the Masan coastal area.
Chapter on Goryeo, discussion following the suppression of the Sambyeolcho. Mobilisation of engineers and workers and requisition of timber and ships for the expeditions to Japan.
“Official letter from Mongol Empire to Japan”, National Archives of Japan 184-0216. Letters transmitted to Goryeo in 1266 and the context of the first expedition.

note.de: Von Happo liefen Schiffe mit Menschen aus Goryeo und dem Yuan-Reich nach Japan aus. Der Kartenausschnitt zeigt die heutige Bucht von Masan. Der genaue Anlegeplatz ist ungewiss.
note.en: Ships from Happo carried Yuan and Goryeo forces to Japan. The map locates the modern harbour at Masan Bay. The precise embarkation point is uncertain.
